# AI v2 design todo, part A (design to update)

# A.21 Canvas (`Canvas.dc.html`, "Canvas — boards, notes and comments on one large plane"). Found by the KBM-14 walk: the whole AI part was deleted from the code and nothing said so

Canvas, boards, notes, locks, history, present and comments stay. Deleted from the app: `canvas/CanvasAi.tsx` (Ask AI panel and proposal review), the proposals API and list, the AI ribbon on a board, "Ask AI" in the create dialog, Ctrl J. An AI changes an HTML frame **directly** with the `canvas_update` tool (files it leaves out stay; a frame a person is editing is refused), commit 64033ace. That the canvas then gets a new version in History is read from the tool's text, not checked in the UI.
